latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Generator from Image — Initial Release

- Instantly turn still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) into 1080p animated video clips with simple text prompts.
- No video editing skills needed — describe your desired animation or export and the AI generates results in ~30-60 seconds.
- Upload, edit with prompts (e.g., "turn this image into a 10-second animated video"), and download your video—all server-side, nothing to install.
- Includes automated session setup, credit tracking, and error handling for a seamless user experience.
- Supports additional features like aspect ratio changes, text overlays, audio tracks, and batch or iterative editing.
